title: Sales Manager
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.


We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Manager to lead our regional sales operations. This role is ideal for a strategic sales leader who thrives on building high-performing teams, driving revenue growth, and expanding profitable client portfolios in competitive markets.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead and drive solution-based sales and account management across designated territories
  • Develop, execute, and own annual sales plans aligned with company revenue and growth targets
  • Build, maintain, and grow profitable client portfolios in line with the company’s strategy
  • Provide accurate sales forecasting, pipeline updates, and reporting via CRM
  • Monitor sales performance, manage sales conversion, and consistently drive revenue growth
  • Recruit, train, motivate, and mentor sales teams to achieve and exceed targets
  • Represent the company at industry events
  • Build strong client relationships to enhance retention and lifetime value
  • Continuously assess sales effectiveness, costs, and results to optimize performance


What You Bring:


  • Proven experience in senior Sales role within Forex, CFDs, or Financial Services
  • Strong leadership skills with a track record of managing and motivating sales teams
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building abilities
  • Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability
  • Experience managing CRM systems, forecasting, and sales analytics
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
  • Willingness to travel for sales events and client meetings when required


What We Offer:


  • Competitive base salary + attractive commission structure
  • Performance-based incentives and bonuses
  • Opportunity to lead and shape regional sales strategy
  • Career growth within a dynamic and expanding FinTech environment
  • Exposure to global markets and cutting-edge trading technology


If you’re a driven sales leader with deep industry experience and a passion for building winning teams, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking


Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.


In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.


Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.


Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.


What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.

Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes.   • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.

  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados

Junte-se a nós!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.

  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus

  • Client-facing experience

  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget

description:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);

  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;

  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;

  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.


Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Cientista de Dados - Sênior
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Cientista de Dados - Sênior



Resumo: Atuar como referência técnica e analítica na estruturação, evolução e confiabilidade dos dados de Ad Intelligence, transformando grandes volumes de dados complexos em insights estratégicos que apoiem decisões de negócio, desenvolvimento de produto e melhoria contínua dos processos operacionais. O cargo combina excelência técnica em Data Science com forte entendimento de mídia, metodologia e negócio, atuando como elo entre Dados, Produto, Operações e áreas comerciais, garantindo que o dado seja consistente, confiável, relevante e acionável para o mercado.



Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar, desenvolver e evoluir metodologias analíticas e modelos de dados aplicados aos produtos de Ad Intelligence, assegurando consistência, robustez e aderência às necessidades do mercado.
  • Conduzir análises aprofundadas de dados para identificar padrões, tendências, anomalias, riscos metodológicos e oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos, processos e entregas.
  • Desenvolver e testar hipóteses de negócio por meio de abordagens quantitativas, apoiando decisões estratégicas e táticas.
  • Atuar como consultor interno para as áreas de Produto, Operações, Taxonomia, Comercial e Liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis.
  • Automatizar análises, relatórios e fluxos de dados, aumentando eficiência operacional, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar continuamente a qualidade, cobertura e consistência dos dados, identificando e investigando desvios, gaps e comportamentos atípicos.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do conhecimento analítico e metodológico da empresa, por meio de documentação, treinamentos, apresentações e troca ativa com outros times.
  • Participar de interações com clientes e fornecedores quando necessário, explicando metodologias, análises e implicações dos dados de forma clara e transparente.

Conhecimento Essencial:

  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e pipelines analíticos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e vice-versa.
  • Comunicação clara, didática e colaborativa.



Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Conhecimento de ambientes de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

  • Conhecimento específico de mídia digital, cross-media, CTV, VOD.
  • Entendimento de mídia, publicidade e métricas de investimento (ou capacidade de aprender rapidamente).
  • Conhecimento de banco relacional e databricks.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.
